title: Kielbasini Paleo
description: A fresh, chewy Vietnamese-inspired dish featuring paleo-friendly kielbasa and other nutritious ingredients that are both light and satisfying.
instructions: Dice red and green bell peppers. Slice onion thinly.
Sauté diced garlic, sliced onions in a pan until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add sliced kielbasa to the pan with vegetables, cook for another 5 minutes or until kielbasa is slightly browned.
Transfer mixture into an oven-safe dish. Combine bell peppers and sprinkle evenly over the top of the mixtures.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, until fully cooked through and edges are golden brown.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
